source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of functional disorders and headache (PDF 51).

blocks.text: Functional bimariyan woh halatein hain jo kisi zahiri banawati (structural) ya jismani (organic) wajah ke baghair nervous system ke naarmal kaam ko mutasir karti hain.

Sar dard ek aam halat hai jis mein sar ya gardan mein dard ya takleef hoti hai. Primary sar dard khud sar dard ki wajah se hote hain, kisi aur wajah se nahin, maslan migraine aur tension wala sar dard. Secondary sar dard sar ya gardan ke kisi andaruni banawati masle ki wajah se hote hain, jaise dimagh mein khoon behna, tumour ya meningitis waghaira. Ilaj mein dard-kush (analgesic) dawayein, tanao kam karna, baqaida warzish aur neend ki behtar aadatein shamil hain.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat ke liye)
blocks.text: Migraine sar dard ki woh qisam hai jis mein sar ki ek taraf ya ek hisse mein shadeed, dhak dhak karta dard hota hai. Migraine dimagh aur khoon ki nalyon mein tabdeeliyon se hoti hai jo sozish aur dard paida karti hain.

blocks.prompt: Meningitis se hone wala sar dard primary hai ya secondary?
blocks.explanation: Secondary: yeh ek andaruni masle, yaani sozish wali meninges, ki wajah se hai.

items: Functional bimariyan: koi zahiri banawati wajah nahin. Sar dard: primary (migraine, tension) ya secondary (khoon behna, tumour, meningitis); ilaj analgesics, kam tanao, warzish, achhi neend.
